title: Docker Containerization
summary: We package applications with dependencies into containers using best practices like multi-stage builds and non-root users.

content.overview: We containerize all applications for consistent environments across dev, staging, and production, using Docker.
content.details: Best practices we follow: use multi-stage builds to reduce image size; never run as root inside containers; use .dockerignore to exclude unnecessary files; pin base image versions. Benefits include consistent environments, isolation, and easy scaling.
